_comment: User-editable known plan limits, checked by reins.services.token_ledger.budget_report(). Neither Anthropic nor Google expose an API to read back remaining account quota, so these numbers are whatever you know your own plan to be - fill in real values and the usage %% will compute against them. Units: 'requests' = call count, 'tokens' = input+output tokens. Omit a window/provider entirely to just show raw usage with no %%.
